scripts.build:shp-wasm: wasm-pack build rust/shp_processor_wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name shp_processor_wasm
scripts.build:shp-wasm:dev: wasm-pack build rust/shp_processor_wasm --target web --dev --out-dir pkg --out-name shp_processor_wasm
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:pipeline:typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:viewshed
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config scripts/pipelines/defra-terrain/vite.config.mjs scripts/pipelines/defra-terrain src/geo/pyramidCatalog.test.ts src/geo/pyramidDerive.test.ts src/geo/groundViewport.test.ts src/geo/LodUtils.test.ts src/geo/tileGeometry.test.ts src/geo/tileRetention.test.ts src/geo/tileLayerManager.test.ts src/geo/pyramidTileNode.test.ts src/geo/zarrPyramid.test.ts src/geo/zarrStoreIndex.test.ts src/geo/compressionFormat.test.ts src/camera/orbitClamp.test.ts src/openjpegjs/textureLruCache.test.ts src/openjpegjs/workerPool.test.ts src/util/timingStats.test.ts src/util/concurrency.test.ts
scripts.test:viewshed: tsc --ignoreConfig --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --strict true --types node --outDir /tmp/terracognita-viewshed-tests src/geo/viewshedConfig.ts src/geo/viewshedConfig.test.ts && node /tmp/terracognita-viewshed-tests/viewshedConfig.test.js
